capabilities: Scan the vault for legacy <mark> highlights and group them by colour
Map each colour to a native highlight colour with suggestions and live preview
Back up affected notes to a timestamped folder before converting
Revert a migration from its backups
Write an optional scan report note with a JSON mapping block
disambiguation: Does not add or style highlights; it only converts existing legacy highlight markup to native syntax.
extras: Conversion needs Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; on older builds the emoji marker shows as literal text. The plugin is listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Vaults contain old HTML highlight markup from plugins like Highlightr that Obsidian's native coloured highlights don't use, and no built-in way converts it safely.

relations.evidence: converts legacy <mark> HTML highlights — like those written by the Highlightr plugin
Add the repository grub-basket/Highlight-Migrator in the BRAT plugin

summary: Migration tool that converts legacy HTML <mark> highlights into Obsidian's native emoji-marker highlight colours, with backup and revert.
